expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of T cells, mostly CD4 T cells (brightest on Tfh), some CD8. Should be uncommon: scattered single cells in stroma, plus clusters inside lymphoid aggregates or follicles and at T-cell-rich tumour borders.
observed: A: several ROIs show PD1 cells clustered in aggregates; two ROIs are hazy across the whole tissue; the rest have scattered dots. B/C: mostly fine grain, few clear cells. D: diffuse haze. E: PD1 patches sit inside CD4-dense regions.
why: PD1 cells cluster in lymphoid aggregates and on CD4-rich areas, but contrast is low, with grain in B/C and whole-tissue haze in some ROIs (and in D).
notes: In A, PD1-positive cells cluster in aggregates in some ROIs, and in E they sit on CD4-rich regions as expected. But B and C are mostly grain, and two ROIs (including the one D comes from) show tissue-wide haze, so treat the PD1 signal as low contrast.
